title: Flooding Spread of Manipulated Knowledge in LLM-Based Multi-Agent Communities
authors: Tianjie Ju; Yiting Wang; Xinbei Ma; Pengzhou Cheng; Haodong Zhao; Yulong Wang; Lifeng Liu; Jian Xie; Zhuosheng Zhang; Gongshen Liu
why_relevant: Demonstrates how manipulated knowledge can persist and spread via RAG when benign agents store and retrieve poisoned chat histories, relevant to adversarial corruption of retrieval corpora in multi-agent settings.
why_not_or_caveat: Primary focus is on multi-agent knowledge spread rather than RAG robustness; RAG persistence is a secondary contribution.
